transaction.new_observation: Source status, root revocations, observation, mappings and every canonical SM3 Outbox page must commit together.
transaction.missing_or_inconsistent_page: Reject and roll back the whole new revocation transaction.
transaction.duplicate: Validate the original complete pages; do not rewrite their payload, hash, capture time or status.
transaction.legacy_observation: Link it only on an explicit later operation as LEGACY_OBSERVATION_LINK, without claiming that the old transaction contained this Outbox.

outbox.invalid_evidence: Abort the append batch, never normalize a coauthorization revocation into EXECUTION_UNKNOWN.

proof_observation.PENDING: Not in the chain; never show covered.
proof_observation.APPENDED_UNANCHORED: One page is hash-linked, but the selected independent checkpoint does not cover it.
proof_observation.EXACT_PAGE_COVERED: The exact page core matches the verified prefix and selected SM2-signed checkpoint.
proof_observation.COMPLETE_RECORDED_OBSERVATION_VERIFIED: The file-only verifier checks every recorded page, counts, selected root binding, full pinned prefix and checkpoint.

boundaries: An audit page is not individually SM2-signed.
The complete recorded observation is not proof of all real-world principals, every other root signature, current live permissions or an independently observed database commit.
Effects admitted before revocation are not cancelled and UNKNOWN reservations are not released.
All referenced original hash/signature domains and V1/V2 encodings remain unchanged.
